questions.question: Out of what did the LORD finally answer Job?
With what question did God begin his answer?
options: Why do you think yourself far wiser than your own Maker?
Can you somehow bring back the days of your youth again?
Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth?
Who has ever given to me, that I should have to repay him?
questions.answer: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth?
